SMALL APP. PERSONAL STUDIO.

Big ideas.
Local processing.

Your Windows download includes the video tools and English speech model. Open the app and get to work. No terminal routine required.

Cloud AI, video links and social connections need internet. Local-file transcription and rendering stay on your computer.

BEFORE YOU HIT DOWNLOAD

A few good
questions.

Do I need to run a server?+

No manual setup. The Windows app starts its own local engine when you open it and closes it with the window.

Can I use it without an AI key?+

Yes. Local speech transcription and video rendering work without a cloud AI key. Without a configured AI service, audio activity helps select clips. Add your own supported provider for AI-assisted selection.

What can I import and export?+

Bring a local video or a supported YouTube, Twitch or Kick video link. Site restrictions may affect downloads. Export captioned 9:16 MP4 clips at 720p or 1080p.

Does it work offline?+

Local-file editing, transcription and rendering work offline with the included model. Video downloads, live capture, cloud AI and social posting require internet.

Is there an Android version?+

An Android 12+ preview supports a smaller local clipping workflow. This page focuses on the Windows studio; the desktop features shown above are not all available on Android.
